jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The programme, administered by the Department of Statistics and Data Science, is intended for students seeking a career in financial and insurance institutions, with a strong interest in scientific methodologies. As an interdisciplinary subject, students enrolled in this programme receive not only solid training in advanced mathematics and statistics, but also comprehensive exposure to finance, economics, accounting, and computer science. The core programme comprises pragmatic courses in numerical methods, portfolio management, financial economics, data structures and accounting principles, which equip students with essential techniques for the highly quantitative work in the financial industry. To meet the increasing demand for talent in data science, the programme has launched a new study stream of risk analytics from the 2017-18 academic year onwards. The new study stream is tailored for students pursuing frontier knowledge in big data technologies in the financial industry. Upon graduation, students are well-equipped to become professional risk managers with a strong background in data science and data analytics.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Mastering the Science of Risk Management in Our Risk Management Science Programme Since its establishment in 2000, the Risk Management Science Programme has been a pioneer in Hong Kong for nurturing well-trained professionals in the risk-management field. The Programme is suitable for students who have strong interest in mathematical and scientific methodologies, and in pursuing a career in the financial industry or related areas. To meet the increasing demand for talent in data science, the programme launched a new study stream of risk analytics in the 2017-18 academic year. The new study stream is tailored for students pursuing frontier knowledge in big data technologies in the financial industry.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: Our graduates have a wide range of career choices in finance, banking, insurance and related areas. New graduates commonly work as assistant risk managers, market risk officers, credit risk officers, market risk analysts, financial analysts, quantitative analysts, actuarial officers, accounting officers, etc. in major commercial banks, investment banks, security houses, insurance companies and accounting firms. Some of our graduates pursue Master’s and doctoral degrees in prestigious schools in Hong Kong and overseas. curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The Risk Management Science programme, administered by the Department of Statistics and Data Science, is designed for students seeking a career in financial and insurance institutions with a strong interest in scientific methodologies.
As an interdisciplinary subject, students receive solid training in advanced mathematics and statistics, as well as comprehensive exposure to finance, economics, accounting, and computer science.
Since 2017-18, the programme has offered a study stream in Risk Analytics, tailored for students pursuing frontier knowledge in big data technologies in the financial industry.
The curriculum also covers state-of-the-art statistical techniques including big data analytics, deep learning, and AI.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: Graduates have a wide range of career choices in finance, banking, insurance, and related areas.
- Investment banks: JPMorgan Chase & Co., Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley
- Accounting and insurance firms: Deloitte & Touche, KPMG
- Government services: Hong Kong Monetary Authority
Some graduates pursue Master's and doctoral degrees at prestigious schools in Hong Kong and overseas.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's main campus is located in Shatin, offering a spacious and scenic environment with modern facilities.
Students belong to one of nine colleges, each providing a unique residential and pastoral experience.
The programme is housed within the Department of Statistics and Data Science, which offers dedicated study spaces and computing labs.
Students can participate in various student societies, sports teams, and cultural activities across the university.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: With a first-year intake of only 25, JS4719 is a highly selective programme.
The median admission score of 43 (Best 5) indicates strong competition, with the lower quartile at 41.5 and upper quartile at 63.75.
Applicants with strong results in Mathematics, M1/M2, and English are particularly competitive.
Interview performance is also a key factor in selection.

alumni.title: Alumni and Faculty Excellence
content: The programme is taught by internationally recognized faculty in statistics, finance, and risk analytics.
Faculty members have published in top-tier journals such as the Journal of Risk and Insurance and the Journal of the American Statistical Association.
The department collaborates with industry partners like the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and major banks for student projects.
Graduates have gone on to leadership roles in banking, finance, and government, contributing to Hong Kong's position as a global financial hub.

scholarships.title: Scholarships and Financial Aid
content: CUHK offers a range of entrance scholarships for outstanding JUPAS students, including full-tuition and half-tuition awards based on HKDSE results.
The University also participates in the HKSAR Government's Targeted Scholarship and Financial Support Scheme (TSFS) and the Non-means-tested Loan Scheme (NLSPS).
Local students may also apply for means-tested financial aid through the Student Financial Assistance Agency (SFAA).

tips.title: Ace Sir's Risk Management Science Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: - The 2025 median is 43; aim for at least this to be competitive.
- With English weighted x2, a strong English grade (5 or above) is crucial.
- Mathematics and M1/M2 at 5* or above significantly boost your score.
- These subjects are core to the programme; high grades demonstrate quantitative aptitude.
- Consider taking M1 or M2 if not already chosen.
- English is weighted double, so a 5** can add 10 points to your score.
- Practice reading comprehension and essay writing for the HKDSE.
- The interview is selective; expect questions on your interest in risk management and quantitative skills.
- Be ready to discuss current financial news or basic probability concepts.
- Choose electives that complement risk management, such as Economics, Business, or ICT.
- A third elective can provide bonus points if your best 5 are already strong.
- All 27 offers in 2025 went to Band A applicants.
- Listing JS4719 as your first choice signals strong interest.
- Familiarise yourself with core courses like Portfolio Management and Financial Economics.
- Mention specific interests in the Risk Analytics stream during your interview.
- Research the nine colleges and their unique features.
- College affiliation can enhance your application by showing cultural fit.
- Explore internships at banks or insurance firms early.
- CUHK's career services and industry connections can help secure placements.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 風險管理科學課程由統計學及數據科學學系開辦，專為有志於金融及保險機構發展、對科學方法有濃厚興趣的學生而設。
作為跨學科課程，學生將接受高等數學及統計學的紮實訓練，並全面接觸金融、經濟、會計及電腦科學。
自 2017-18 學年起，課程增設風險分析學研組，專為有志於金融業大數據技術前沿知識的學生而設。
課程亦涵蓋最新統計技術，包括大數據分析、深度學習及人工智能。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生在金融、銀行、保險及相關領域擁有廣泛的就業選擇。
- 投資銀行：摩根大通、高盛、摩根士丹利
- 會計及保險公司：德勤、畢馬威
- 政府機構：香港金融管理局
- 其他（教育、電腦工程、資訊科技）：約 13%
部分畢業生於香港及海外著名學府攻讀碩士及博士學位。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學主校園位於沙田，環境寬敞優美，設施現代化。
學生隸屬於九所書院之一，每所書院提供獨特的住宿及全人教育體驗。
課程所屬的統計學及數據科學學系設有專用研習空間及電腦實驗室。
學生可參與各類學生組織、運動隊伍及校園文化活動。

competitiveness.title: 競爭情況
content: 首年學額僅 25 個，JS4719 屬高選擇性課程。
- 每學額 Band A 申請人數：3.7
中位數入學分數為 43（最佳五科），下四分位數 41.5，上四分位數 63.75，競爭激烈。
數學、M1/M2 及英國語文成績優異的申請者更具優勢。
面試表現亦是甄選關鍵因素。

alumni.title: 校友及教研成就
content: 課程由國際知名的統計學、金融學及風險分析學教授任教。
教研人員曾在《風險與保險期刊》及《美國統計協會期刊》等頂尖學術期刊發表論文。
學系與香港金融管理局及主要銀行合作，為學生提供項目實踐機會。
畢業生已在銀行、金融及政府部門擔任領導角色，為香港作為國際金融中心的地位作出貢獻。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及資助
content: 香港中文大學為優秀 JUPAS 學生提供多項入學獎學金，包括全額及半額學費減免，按文憑試成績頒發。
大學亦參與政府「特定獎學金及財政支援計劃」（TSFS）及「免入息審查貸款計劃」（NLSPS）。
本地學生亦可透過學生資助處（SFAA）申請經入息審查的資助。

tips.title: Ace Sir 的風險管理科學策略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 目標分數：爭取最佳五科 43 分或以上**
- 2025 年中位數為 43 分，以此為目標以增加競爭力。
- 英國語文比重 x2，取得 5 級或以上至關重要。
- 數學及 M1/M2 達 5* 或以上可大幅提升分數。
- 這些科目是課程核心，高分數展示量化能力。
- 如未選修，可考慮加修 M1 或 M2。
- 英國語文比重雙計，5** 可為總分增加 10 分。
- 多練習閱讀理解及寫作，為文憑試做好準備。
- 面試具選擇性，預計會問及你對風險管理的興趣及量化技能。
- 準備討論近期金融新聞或基本概率概念。
- 選擇與風險管理相關的選修科，如經濟、商業或資訊及通訊科技。
- 如最佳五科已夠強，第三選修科可提供額外分數。
- 2025 年所有 27 個錄取名額均來自 Band A 申請者。
- 將 JS4719 列為首志願顯示強烈興趣。
- 熟悉投資組合管理及金融經濟學等核心科目。
- 面試時可提及對風險分析學研組的具體興趣。
- 研究九所書院及其特色。
- 書院歸屬感可展示文化契合度，提升申請優勢。
- 及早尋找銀行或保險公司的實習機會。
- 中文大學的就業服務及業界聯繫有助獲取實習職位。
